method: Claude web search, 4 queries, 2026-11-27. Official sources cited where found; aggregator/guide sites (bankbazaar, citizennest, righttoinformation.wiki) used ONLY as evidence that a problem is common, never for facts. No Reddit threads were found. real_phrasings are written by Claude, not copied from users: treat them as drafts and replace with real wording when available. Every link needs a human click-check from India.
global_findings: nfsa.gov.in online ration services have been discontinued in at least Goa after migration to the state SMART-PDS Ration Card Management System (new card, transfer, add/delete member, surrender). Source: https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/MIGRATION-TO-NEW-SMART-PDS.pdf. Our cards that link nfsa.gov.in/portal/apply must be re-checked per state.

Helpline 14445 was allotted by DoT to the Department of Food & Public Distribution for national ration-card portability grievances. Source: https://dot.gov.in/accessservices/allotment-short-code-14445-helpline-purpose-national-portability-ration-cards. Current operating status UNVERIFIED.

Helpline 1967 is listed as a toll-free PDS call-centre number in a West Bengal food department notice: https://food.wb.gov.in/food/UserAdministration/uploads_Notice/789_20250530_120335_5837.pdf. Whether 1967 works in every state is UNVERIFIED.
PIB: linking or non-linking of Aadhaar with a ration card is not a criterion for deletion/cancellation under NFSA. Source: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1808675

situations.situation: Moved to another city or state and needs ration there now
real_phrasings: I moved to Bengaluru, can I get ration here with my Bihar card?
shifted to a new city, how do I get my ration
can I take ration in another state
dusre state mein ration kaise milega
naye sheher mein ration card chalega kya
situations.why_stuck: People assume they need a new card; portability (ONORC) lets NFSA cardholders collect at any fair price shop, but many do not know it or the shop refuses.

clarifying_questions.q: Do you need ration now, or do you want to move your card permanently?

branches.next_step: Go to any fair price shop near your new home and ask to collect your ration under portability.
branches.authority: Department of Food & Public Distribution (portability system); state food department for the shop
keep_ready: Aadhaar of the member collecting (fingerprint check)
if_it_fails: Shop refuses: call the state food helpline (1967 listed in some states, UNVERIFIED for all states) or 14445 (status UNVERIFIED)
Fingerprint fails: see situation 'Biometric authentication failed at the shop'

branches.next_step: See situation 'Move the ration card to a new state'.

situations.state_variation: Portability applies to NFSA cards; state-scheme (non-NFSA) cards may not be portable across states. Which states fully support portability today: UNVERIFIED.

situations.situation: Move the ration card to a new state permanently
real_phrasings: how to transfer ration card from one state to another
I shifted to Pune, how do I get a Maharashtra ration card
ration card surrender certificate kaise milega
ration card transfer kaise kare dusre state mein
do I need to cancel my old ration card to apply in new state
situations.why_stuck: Two states are involved: the old state must issue a surrender/deletion certificate, the new state issues the card. Each state uses its own portal and document list.

clarifying_questions.q: Have you already surrendered your old card?

branches.next_step: Apply to surrender your old card with your old state's food department (District Supply Office or its online service) and get a surrender certificate.
branches.authority: Food & Civil Supplies Department of the OLD state (District Supply Officer)
branches.official_link: UNVERIFIED: varies by state; example Uttarakhand https://fcs.uk.gov.in/pages/display/123-ration-card-transfer
keep_ready: Application form of the old state
if_it_fails: No response: complain to the District Supply Officer of the old district
Cannot travel back: check whether the old state offers online surrender (UNVERIFIED per state)

branches.next_step: Apply for a new ration card on your NEW state's food department portal.
branches.authority: Food & Civil Supplies Department of the NEW state
branches.official_link: UNVERIFIED: state portal; nfsa.gov.in no longer handles this in some states (Goa notice)
keep_ready: Proof of new address (electricity/water bill or rent agreement)
if_it_fails: Pending past the state's service timeline: escalate to the District Supply Officer
Rejected: re-apply with the listed missing document or appeal to the DSO

situations.state_variation: Document lists, fees and whether surrender is online differ by state. Uttarakhand lists a surrender certificate from the DSO (urban) or Gram Panchayat officer (rural).

situations.situation: Biometric (fingerprint) authentication failed at the ration shop
real_phrasings: fingerprint not matching at ration shop
my mother's thumb is not working on ration machine
ration denied because biometric failed
ration dukan pe angutha match nahi ho raha
machine mein finger nahi lag raha ration nahi de raha
situations.why_stuck: Elderly and manual workers often fail fingerprint checks; dealers turn people away instead of using alternatives.
evidence: https://uidai.gov.in/images/rajyasabha/RSPQ394(Unstarred).pdf (official: denial due to authentication failure acknowledged)

branches.next_step: Ask the dealer to use another member of the family on the card, or an alternative authentication method, and if refused call the food helpline.
branches.authority: State Food & Civil Supplies Department (District Supply Officer)
keep_ready: Aadhaar of another family member on the card
if_it_fails: Still refused: call the state food helpline (1967 in some states, UNVERIFIED for all)
No help from helpline: written complaint to the District Supply Officer

situations.state_variation: Fallback methods (OTP, iris, nominee) and exception rules are set by each state: UNVERIFIED. A guide site claims a Supreme Court ruling against denial for authentication failure: UNVERIFIED, not found in an official source.

situations.situation: Ration dealer gives less grain, refuses, or overcharges
real_phrasings: ration dealer is giving less rice
ration shop asking for extra money
dealer says stock finished every month
ration wala kam anaaj deta hai
kotedar ration nahi de raha
situations.why_stuck: People do not know complaints go to the state food department, not the dealer or the central government.

branches.next_step: Call the state food helpline and register a complaint against the fair price shop.
branches.authority: State Food & Civil Supplies Department (District Supply Officer)
branches.official_link: UNVERIFIED: state grievance portal; NFSA lists state helplines at https://nfsa.gov.in/
keep_ready: Shop name or number and location
if_it_fails: No action: written complaint to the District Supply Officer
Still no action: complaint to the State Food Commission (UNVERIFIED per state)

situations.state_variation: Helpline numbers and grievance portals differ by state.

situations.situation: Add a family member (newborn, spouse) or the addition is pending
real_phrasings: how to add my baby's name to ration card
added wife's name but still not showing
name addition pending for 2 months
ration card mein bacche ka naam kaise jode
naam add kiya tha abhi tak nahi aaya
situations.why_stuck: Additions go through the state portal and need eKYC; applications stall silently.

branches.next_step: Apply to add the member on your state food department's ration card portal or at the food office.
if_it_fails: Rejected: check the reason on the state portal and re-apply
Portal error: apply at the district/taluk food office

branches.next_step: Check the application status on the state portal, then escalate to the District Supply Officer if it is past the state's service timeline.
if_it_fails: Still pending: complaint under the state's Right to Service Act, where one exists (UNVERIFIED per state)

situations.state_variation: Timelines (a guide claims 30 days under state Right to Service Acts: UNVERIFIED) and documents differ by state.

situations.situation: Name or ration card deleted or cancelled
real_phrasings: my name was removed from the ration card list
ration card cancelled without reason
card deleted because Aadhaar not linked
ration card se naam kat gaya
ration card band ho gaya kya kare
situations.why_stuck: Deletions happen in bulk clean-ups (eKYC, duplicates); people get no notice.

branches.next_step: Apply to the District Supply Officer for restoration or re-inclusion, quoting the reason given (if any).
branches.authority: District Supply Officer, State Food & Civil Supplies Department
if_it_fails: No reason given: file an RTI with the district supply office asking why the card was deleted
Rejected: appeal to the district grievance officer / State Food Commission (UNVERIFIED per state)

situations.state_variation: Restoration process differs by state. Per PIB, non-linking of Aadhaar alone is not a criterion for deletion under NFSA.
